description: The public record for one school on EduAtlas: type, phase, pupils, head teacher, trust, latest Ofsted judgement (England: an overall grade, or since November 2025 a report card), contact phone, website, and how many live vacancies it has. Identify the school by its EduAtlas slug (from a job result or a URL like https://eduatlas.org/schools/<slug>) or by name plus country, optionally with a town; schools that share a name are listed.

city.description: Optional town, to tell apart schools that share a name.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, required with name.

name.description: School name, used with country when slug is unknown.

name: get_school
title: Get a school record
